shared_tail.surface: إسحاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طلحة

notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Malik: the text writes «مالكا» in the first and «مالك، بن أنس» in the second (rule 3)
What follows Malik, Ishaq b. Abd Allah and Anas b. Malik, is written once and is the shared tail
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
